title: Centrate nitrogen: four-stream metathesis, finite inventories and complete service costs

reported_status: Completed available P3 constructs four-compartment electrodialysis metathesis with segregated sodium return, purchased sulfate donor, CO2/speciation control, hardness guard, RO and paid evaporation. Favorable potential product 4.613 kg N/4.960 kg admitted TAN is conditional, not measured accepted fertilizer. Guard occupancy and retained-liquid scenario lowers it to 4.147 kg/83.6% and fails proposed sodium quality. Favorable cold campaign 46.242 kWh/10.02 kWh per potential kg N and ordinary RO implementation about 73.05 kWh/15.84 fail the 3 kWh/kg target. Introduced industrial $5.10M/$9.957 per kg N misses capital, service cost and matched advantage. Full useful invention remains open; this is not an all-process impossibility result.
